name: cicy-r2
title: CiCy R2
description: Upload, download, list, and manage objects in the project Cloudflare R2 bucket (public CDN at r2.deepfetch.de5.net). Global-friendly replacement for the arrears-prone Tencent COS bucket.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: CiCy R2
zh-CN.description: 上传、下载、列出和管理 Cloudflare R2 存储桶对象，支持通过已配置的自定义域名生成公开访问链接，并利用 Cloudflare 边缘网络分发静态资源。

tools.name: cicy-r2 put
tools.description: Upload a local file to R2 under a key

tools.name: cicy-r2 list
tools.description: List objects (optionally by key prefix) via CF REST API

tools.name: cicy-r2 url
tools.description: Print the public CDN URL for a key
